hypotheses.expect: A root's .artifact-journal.jsonl holds one line per record path, that path's newest entry, so it grows only with the record set. Every entry the door writes is also appended to a trail of one file per UTC day under ~/.cairn/logs, which the existing logs sweep ages out at 30 days.
